assertions.title: Profile output is a formatted Rich table

steps.action: Run `uv run mlx-stack profile` with isolated MLX_STACK_HOME
steps.expected: Formatted table with chip, GPU cores, memory, bandwidth, and profile ID rows
steps.observed: Rich-formatted table rendered with all required rows and exit code 0

steps.action: Run `uv run mlx-stack profile` and record profile.json mtime
Run `uv run mlx-stack profile` again after delay and compare mtime
steps.expected: Second run overwrites profile.json with newer timestamp
steps.observed: MTIME_RUN2 > MTIME_RUN1 and second run exited 0

steps.action: Prepend mock failing `sysctl` binary in PATH and run `uv run mlx-stack profile`
steps.expected: Descriptive error, non-zero exit, and no Python traceback
steps.observed: Output showed `Error: sysctl failed... simulated sysctl failure`, exit code 1, and no traceback
